resources.string: WEB proxy uses an HTTPS page inside a private WebView. Enter a hostname without a scheme or path and a 16-byte MTProxy secret. This proof of concept requires a current Android System WebView and is intended for foreground testing.
60 FPS is used only when both front and rear cameras support it. Otherwise recording falls back to 30 FPS.
Disable styling to record a plain square without outside-circle blur, dimming or Telegram overlays.
